about_the_game:
Erden: The Climb is an incremental RPG about climbing a seemingly endless tower floor by floor that combines short active bursts of play with idle phases centered around resource gathering. Engage in automatic combat with active elements, gather resources, craft items and grow in power with the help of multiple progression systems.

The Tower

Defeat enemies on each floor and claim the rewards - materials to craft powerful equipment and the secrets of magic.

Equipment

Craft gear, improve it through repeated usage and awaken your weapons. Retrace the steps of souls of past bound to the awakened weapons for additional benefits. Inscribe and equip runes to wield powerful magic.

Crafting

Craft everything. Weapons, armor, accessories and magical runes. Food, potions, enchantments and magical scrolls.

Combat

Fight enemies in an automatic battle system that allows you to manually use consumables in real time - spell scrolls, potions, food and other items providing advantage. Idle away to grind for experience and resources.

Enchantments

Enchant your equipment with enchantments, either empowering your strengths or covering your weaknesses. Slay enemies for a chance to get their card - a powerful version of enchantments.

Skills

Discover and improve a multitude of skills by doing their respective actions. Get hit? Tenacity! Throw a fireball? Mana Control and Fire Affinity! Cook a steak? Cooking! Stuff your face? Gluttony! Spend money? Trading! And more, a lot more. Reach proficiency thresholds for additional benefits.

Quests

Visit the Adventurers' Guild and complete quests to receive money and useful items in return. Gather reputation to rank up and receive more difficult and rewarding quests.

Blessings

Accept the Tower's Blessings to acquire great power... at a great cost.

Lore

What is the Tower, why did it appear? What's the secret behind it? Get to know other climbers. Learn about those of the past and their mistakes.

- Playable Demo Version -

There is a playable web-based demo available on our website (see right panel of the steam page for a link). The save files between the web-based demo and the final version will NOT be compatible. There will be a Steam demo available together with the release of the full version, with compatible save files.

content_descriptors.notes: Text-based fantasy violence, murder, death and suicide. Hinted usage of fantasy, non-existent substances / drugs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10; 64bit
  • Processor: 2.7GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3, 1GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Climb the seemingly endless Tower for its riches and magic. Accept its blessings, craft equipment, bond with your weapons and become stronger. What awaits at the Tower's summit? Incremental RPG that combines short active bursts with idle resource gathering.
